verdicts.reason: A puts the CTA on the far left ahead of the headline, so the reading order runs backwards. Its '48H ONLY' badge has shrunk to an unreadable pink dot, the VOLTSTRIDE box is cropped at the right edge, and the stripe pattern is cut down to a sliver, so the brand feel is mostly lost. B keeps the striped panel with a readable badge and the full box on the left, then headline and CTA running left to right with clear hierarchy; its only real flaws are a small, low-sitting subline and a box crowded against the edge of the stripe panel.
